title: Corset Collector Arena
description: The player controls a ReadyPlayer.me avatar in a 3D arena where glowing corset power-ups spawn at random positions. The avatar must navigate to collect corsets within a time limit, each pickup triggering a score increase, a visual burst effect, and progressive difficulty scaling with faster spawn timers and moving corsets.
prompt: Create a single HTML file using Three.js r170 (importmap from cdn.jsdelivr.net) that implements a 3D collection game. Load the ReadyPlayer.me avatar from 'shared_assets/readyplayer.me.glb' as the player character and 'shared_assets/Corset.glb' as collectible items. Setup: Use a flat grid-textured ground plane (30x30 units) as the arena. Place the avatar at center. Add ambient light (intensity 0.6) and a directional light casting shadows. Set the camera in third-person perspective behind and above the avatar using a follow-cam that smoothly tracks the player. HUD: Display score, time remaining (60 seconds), and corsets collected as an HTML overlay. Interactions (minimum 7 steps validated): 1) WASD keys move the avatar across the arena with parameter validation ensuring the avatar stays within arena bounds (clamp position to ±14 units). 2) Arrow keys rotate the avatar's facing direction (left/right arrows, validate rotation is normalized). 3) Corsets spawn every 3 seconds at random positions within bounds (validate spawn coordinates are within arena). 4) When avatar is within 1.5 units of a corset, collect it: remove the corset, increment score by 10, play a particle burst (small spheres expanding outward then fading). 5) After collecting 3 corsets, difficulty increases: spawn interval decreases to 2 seconds and corsets slowly orbit their spawn point (validate orbit radius 1-2 units). 6) After collecting 6 corsets, corsets begin floating up and down with sine-wave motion (amplitude 0.5-1.5, validate range). 7) Pressing Space triggers a dash move doubling speed for 0.5 seconds with a 3-second cooldown (validate cooldown timer before allowing re-use). Scale the corset model to roughly 1/3 avatar height. Add a subtle golden point-light to each corset. When timer hits zero, show a game-over overlay with final score and a restart button that resets all state. Use GLTFLoader for both models. Animate with requestAnimationFrame.
